summary: docs/ holds 442 files (~17.3 MB). Only 23 of them (~1.9 MB, mostly the three generated JSON files) are current documentation. The other 419 are development history: prompt-N evidence trees with screenshots, JUnit XML, .before/.after/.patch source backups and copied source files; dated multi-agent logs (kilavuz-2026-10-18-*); stage plans; audits; todo/done archives; test reports. tools/radios_package.py:36 currently ships 280 of these history files (4.7 MB) to users, and the planned Windows zip/NSIS layout would ship docs\** as well. No code reads a history doc. The functional links to docs/ and design/ are: CMake + css_to_gtk.py (design CSS → embedded GTK CSS), islev_envanteri.py (writes and checks docs/islev-envanteri.json and docs/sdbase-openapi.json), radios_package.py COMMON_FILES/TREES plus test_packaging.py (need the README files, a docs tree and design/reference/tasarrım/index.html), the protected-directory lists (storage_locations.c, radios_database.py, desktop_transfer_package.py) and the docs/api.md reference in openapi.py. Everything else is one of nine comment pointers. The spec gives a mechanical manifest: keep 10 docs as they are; rename 13 to topic names (no NN- stage prefixes, dates or kilavuz folder); delete 33 top-level files, 10 subfolders, design/prompt3-requirements.md and 11 SDBASE audit/report docs. Before deleting, contracts are copied out of 6 history files into new docs (mimari, aktarim-paketi, gecis-dagilimi-sozlesmesi, fiziksel-kabul) plus three inserts. The section numbers and rule letters that code comments cite are kept. Checked on this machine: MSYS2 CMake/Ninja handle the non-ASCII tasarrım path, so no rename is needed. MSYS2 Python uses cp1254 by default, so css_to_gtk.py currently fails on index.html. islev_envanteri.py is blocked by the SDBASE fcntl import, and its JSON output is already stale, so it must be regenerated after the port. The spec lists every Linux statement and every piece of version-history narration in the surviving docs/READMEs by file:line, with a Linux→Windows wording table (run-radios.cmd/run-database.cmd, runtime\python\python.exe -E -s -B -X utf8, WASAPI/WinMM, private ACL, LockFileEx, Local\RadioS-stop-<pid>, drive/UNC paths, no Flatpak/SDK). It also gives a Turkish outline for the new README (features, requirements, NSIS/zip install, MSYS2 build, run, data/config, service management, backup, packaging, tests, tools, layout, docs index) and for tests/README. Nothing is lost by deleting: all history stays in the untouched Linux folder.
